titleZh: 课堂参与不止一种方式

sources.title: UNESCO IESALC · How can we create university classrooms in which everyone has genuine opportunities to learn?
University of Washington · Universal Design for Learning（课堂设计背景）

cet4.title: More Than One Way to Take Part
cet4.summary: 从 UNESCO IESALC 近期公布的 11 月教学会议出发，讨论不同参与方式；课程设计实例为教学设想，会议尚未举行。

paragraphs.text: A university classroom can be open to everyone and still be difficult for some students to use. In an October 15, 2026 article, UNESCO IESALC described a forthcoming teaching conference focused on inclusion. The event is planned for November 3, online and free of charge. Its programme includes accessible presentations and ways to reduce barriers to learning. It has not yet taken place.
paragraphs.translation: 大学课堂即使向所有人开放，仍可能让部分学生难以参与。UNESCO IESALC 在 2026 年 10 月 15 日的文章中介绍了一场关注包容性教学的即将举行的会议。活动计划于 11 月 3 日免费在线举行，议程包括易于理解和使用的演示，以及减少学习障碍的方法。目前会议尚未举行。

paragraphs.text: The question goes beyond whether a student can enter a room. A diagram with no spoken explanation may be hard to follow. A discussion that rewards the fastest speaker may miss a thoughtful answer. The format of an activity can influence participation before anyone has checked what learners understand. Changing that format may give students a better chance to show the same learning.
paragraphs.translation: 问题不只在于学生能否进入房间。没有口头说明的图示可能难以理解；奖励最快发言者的讨论可能错过经过思考的回答。在检验学习者理解之前，活动形式就可能影响参与。改变形式，可能使学生更有机会展示相同的学习成果。

paragraphs.text: Consider a hypothetical seminar. The teacher could give students a short question in advance, allow time to think independently and then invite discussion in pairs. A written response could provide another route into the conversation. These options would challenge assumptions about who is ready to contribute. A flexible arrangement would not guarantee that every student participates, but it could remove an unnecessary obstacle to doing so.
paragraphs.translation: 设想一节研讨课：教师可以提前给出简短问题，让学生独立思考，再邀请他们两人讨论。书面回答可以提供进入讨论的另一条路径。这些选择能挑战关于谁已准备好贡献想法的假设。灵活安排不保证每名学生都参与，但可能去掉一个不必要的参与障碍。

paragraphs.text: This does not require giving up clear standards. If the goal is to explain an argument, students should still provide reasons and evidence. Different ways to respond can be judged by that shared goal. Consultation matters too: teachers can ask which instruction was unclear and which option helped. They should not assume that silence means either complete understanding or a lack of interest.
paragraphs.translation: 这不要求放弃明确标准。如果目标是解释论点，学生仍应提供理由和证据。不同回答方式可依据这一共同目标评价。征求意见也很重要：教师可以询问哪些说明不清楚、哪些选择有帮助，而不应假定沉默意味着完全理解或缺乏兴趣。

paragraphs.text: A practical starting point is to improve one activity and evaluate the result. Did more students understand how to begin? Could they explain the idea afterwards? The University of Washington’s teaching guidance similarly suggests adding another option where learners face a common difficulty. Small changes can make a classroom easier to approach while keeping attention on what students are expected to learn, rather than simply making the lesson look different.
paragraphs.translation: 实际起点是改进一项活动，再评估结果：更多学生知道如何开始了吗？事后能解释概念吗？华盛顿大学的教学指引同样建议，在学习者经常遇到困难的地方增加一种选择。小改变可以让课堂更容易参与，同时把注意力留在预期学习内容上，而不只是让课程看起来不同。

vocabulary.meaning: 让不同学习者都能参与

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指课堂材料和活动形式中让部分学生难以进入学习的因素。

examples.text: Unclear instructions can create barriers for new members.
examples.translation: 不清楚的说明可能为新成员制造障碍。

examples.text: The redesign removed several barriers to using the website.
examples.translation: 重新设计消除了使用网站时的几个障碍。

focusWords.meaning: 假设；未经证实的想当然
focusWords.contextMeaning: 指根据发言速度等表象判断谁已准备好参与，而未检查真实理解。

examples.text: We should test our assumptions before changing the timetable.
examples.translation: 改变时间表前，我们应检验自己的假设。

examples.text: Her question challenged the assumptions behind the plan.
examples.translation: 她的问题质疑了计划背后的假设。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指询问学生对说明与参与方式的实际体验，为调整教学提供依据。

examples.text: The new schedule was developed in consultation with students.
examples.translation: 新的时间表是在征求学生意见后制定的。

examples.text: Consultation helped the group understand which changes were useful.
examples.translation: 征求意见帮助小组了解哪些改变有用。

questions.prompt: What is the main point of the passage?
options: A successful classroom should reward the quickest response.
New teaching formats should be judged mainly by their appearance.
Providing different routes to participation can support a shared learning goal.
The number of students speaking is a complete measure of understanding.
questions.explanation: 全文以不同参与路径、共同标准及效果评价展开，主旨是 C。A、D 以发言表现代替理解，B 则忽略了最后一段要求检查真实学习效果。

questions.prompt: What is said about the conference mentioned in paragraph 1?
options: It has already reported improvements in participating universities.
It is planned as a free online event on November 3.
It is limited to teachers who can attend in person.
It was held on the same date as the October article.
questions.explanation: 第一段明确区分报道日期 10 月 15 日与会议计划日期 11 月 3 日，并说明免费在线、尚未举行，因此选 B。A、D 把计划或报道误当成已经发生的活动。

questions.prompt: What would remain important when students respond in different ways?
options: Using the same response format for every task.
Keeping the reasons for the activity unstated.
Selecting the answer given with the least hesitation.
Applying the shared goal of explaining with reasons and evidence.
questions.explanation: 第四段指出形式可以不同，但仍应按解释论点、提供理由和证据的共同目标评价，D 正确。A 把共同标准误解为形式完全相同，C 则再次以速度代替理解。

questions.prompt: Which conclusion about a silent student is most reasonable according to the passage?
options: Further information is needed before deciding what the silence means.
The student has already understood the argument completely.
The student would not benefit from a written response option.
The student’s interest can be measured by speaking speed.
questions.explanation: 第四段要求不要把沉默直接等同于完全理解或无兴趣，因此应进一步了解原因，选 A。B 只是被明确提醒避免的一种假定，C、D 也缺少依据。

questions.prompt: The word “flexible” in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to _____.
options: unchanged for every learner
able to offer different suitable ways of taking part
less concerned with the learning goal
designed mainly to shorten the discussion
questions.explanation: 第三段列出提前提问、独立思考、两人讨论和书面回答等选择，flexible 指可提供不同合适参与方式，B 正确。C 把灵活误解为降低或放弃目标。

cet6.title: Designing Participation Without Diluting Expectations
cet6.summary: 以尚待举行的包容性大学教学会议为引子，区分可及性、参与方式与共同学术要求；研讨课情境为假设。

paragraphs.text: Access to a university does not automatically ensure access to the learning within it. An October 15, 2026 UNESCO IESALC article announced a teaching conference scheduled for November 3, online and free of charge, with inclusion as a central concern. Accessible presentations and teaching strategies feature in its programme. The event remains forthcoming, so no completed outcomes can yet be inferred from it. Its agenda instead offers a starting point for considering accessibility as deliberate course design.
paragraphs.translation: 进入大学并不自动保证能够参与其中的学习。UNESCO IESALC 在 2026 年 10 月 15 日的文章中公布了一场计划于 11 月 3 日免费在线举行的教学会议，包容性是核心议题。易于接触和理解的演示及教学策略是议程内容。活动尚待举行，因此还不能据此推断已完成的效果；它的议程可以作为把可及性视为有意课程设计的思考起点。

paragraphs.text: Participation is shaped by arrangements that can look neutral from the front of a room. An unexplained diagram, a rapid exchange of questions or a single compulsory response format may each obscure what a learner actually understands. A student who needs time to organise an answer can appear unprepared in a discussion that rewards immediate speech. The resulting pattern may reflect the structure of the opportunity as much as the distribution of knowledge among those present.
paragraphs.translation: 从讲台前看似中性的安排，也会塑造参与方式。未加说明的图示、快速问答或唯一强制的回答形式，都可能遮蔽学习者的真实理解。需要时间组织答案的学生，在奖励即时发言的讨论中可能显得准备不足。由此形成的参与模式，可能与机会的结构有关，正如它与在场者知识分布有关一样。

paragraphs.text: A hypothetical seminar illustrates a possible adjustment. Students could receive a question beforehand, prepare a brief response and then discuss it with a partner before addressing the larger group. A written contribution could offer another route into the same analytical task. The relevant constraint would remain the quality of the reasoning required. Equivalence does not demand an identical performance format; it requires a considered account of whether different routes allow learners to demonstrate the same intended ability.
paragraphs.translation: 一个假设研讨课说明了可能的调整。学生可以提前收到问题、准备简短回答，先与同伴讨论，再面向更大的群体发言。书面贡献可提供进入同一分析任务的另一条路径。相关约束仍然是要求的推理质量。等效不要求表现形式完全一致，而需要经过考虑地判断，不同路径是否让学习者展示同一种预期能力。

paragraphs.text: This is where accessibility and rigour can support one another. If the aim is to analyse an argument, evidence, coherence and justified conclusions remain essential. A format that creates an unrelated obstacle does not necessarily make that analysis more demanding in a useful way. Removing the obstacle can reveal stronger evidence of learning. It does not follow that every option is appropriate for every objective: a task specifically assessing spoken interaction would require a different judgment from one assessing written analysis.
paragraphs.translation: 在这一点上，可及性与严格要求可以互相支持。如果目标是分析论点，证据、连贯性和有依据的结论仍必不可少。制造无关障碍的形式，不一定以有用的方式提高分析难度。消除障碍可以更清楚地显示学习证据。这不意味着每个选择都适合每个目标：专门评价口头互动的任务，与评价书面分析的任务，需要作出不同判断。

paragraphs.text: Consultation should accompany the redesign. Asking students where instructions became unclear or which preparation helped can expose difficulties that an instructor’s retrospective impression misses. Feedback should inform a specific change and a later check, rather than merely record satisfaction. The University of Washington’s guidance on Universal Design for Learning proposes a manageable approach of adding one more option at a point where learners commonly struggle. Such a change can be tested without claiming that a single redesign has resolved every barrier.
paragraphs.translation: 重新设计应当伴随征求意见。询问学生说明在哪里变得不清楚、哪种准备有帮助，可以揭示教师事后印象遗漏的困难。反馈应促成具体改变和后续检查，而不只是记录满意程度。华盛顿大学关于学习通用设计的指引提出一种可管理的办法：在学习者常遇到困难的地方增加一个选择。这种改变可以得到检验，无需声称一次设计就解决所有障碍。

paragraphs.text: The broader goal is sustainable participation in demanding learning. Teachers need not conflate a shared intellectual expectation with a uniform route towards meeting it. Nor should a more varied lesson be celebrated without examining what learners can subsequently explain or do. A useful design makes the task easier to approach while keeping its purpose visible. Inclusion then concerns the conditions under which ability can develop and be demonstrated, rather than a decorative promise attached to an otherwise unchanged classroom.
paragraphs.translation: 更广泛的目标，是让学生能够持续参与有要求的学习。教师不必把共同的知识要求与达到要求的统一路径混为一谈，也不应在未检查学习者随后能解释或完成什么之前，就为更丰富的课程喝彩。有用的设计让任务更容易进入，同时保持目标清晰。包容由此涉及能力得以发展和展示的条件，而非附在原样课堂上的装饰性承诺。

vocabulary.meaning: 可及性；易于参与的程度
有意为之的；经过考虑的

focusWords.meaning: 等效；相等；具有同等作用
focusWords.contextMeaning: 指不同参与方式能展示相同的预期分析能力，不意味着形式完全一致。

examples.text: The course team examined the equivalence of the two assessment routes.
examples.translation: 课程团队检查了两种评价路径是否等效。

examples.text: Equivalence depends on what the tasks measure, not how similar they look.
examples.translation: 是否等效取决于任务评价什么，而不是外观有多相似。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指分析任务仍要求证据、连贯推理和合理结论，不因增加参与途径而放弃。

examples.text: The tutor praised the rigour of her analysis.
examples.translation: 导师称赞了她分析的严谨性。

examples.text: Clear explanations can improve accessibility without reducing intellectual rigour.
examples.translation: 清楚的解释可以提高可及性，而不降低思考的严谨程度。

focusWords.meaning: 把不同事物混为一谈；合并而不作区分
focusWords.contextMeaning: 指不应把共同学习要求与统一参与形式当作同一回事。

examples.text: Do not conflate a quick response with a well-supported answer.
examples.translation: 不要把反应迅速与回答有充分依据混为一谈。

examples.text: The report conflates attendance with active participation.
examples.translation: 报告把出席与积极参与混为一谈。

questions.prompt: Which statement best represents the author’s argument?
options: Accessible course design can preserve intellectual demands while widening routes to participation.
Uniform response formats are the clearest evidence that assessment standards are shared.
More varied classroom activities can be assumed to improve learning without evaluation.
The main purpose of inclusion is to replace challenging analytical work with easier tasks.
questions.explanation: 全文区分共同学术目标与不同参与路径，并要求评价设计效果，A 概括最完整。B 把统一标准误同于统一形式，C 跳过检验，D 则把消除无关障碍误写为降低任务要求。

questions.prompt: What does paragraph 2 suggest about apparently uneven classroom participation?
options: It necessarily reflects differences in the knowledge students possess.
It can be corrected chiefly by increasing the speed of questioning.
It shows that every quiet student prefers written assessment.
It may be influenced by the way opportunities to contribute are structured.
questions.explanation: 第二段以需要组织答案的学生为例，说明参与表象也可能来自活动安排，因此选 D。A 过度归因于知识差异，C 把一种可选路径错误推广为所有安静学生的偏好。

questions.prompt: When would the author consider a different judgment about response formats necessary?
options: When a redesigned seminar includes time for individual preparation.
When students provide reasons for preferring one format over another.
When the task specifically aims to assess spoken interaction.
When a teacher wants the purpose of an activity to remain visible.
questions.explanation: 第四段明确区分专门评价口头互动与书面分析的任务，前者对回应形式需要不同判断，故选 C。其他选项只是设计或评价过程的组成部分，并非文中提出的目标差异。

questions.prompt: Which evidence would most directly support the success of a redesigned activity?
options: The teacher reports that the lesson looks more varied than before.
Students can demonstrate the intended reasoning through the available routes.
A single popular format is adopted across tasks with different objectives.
Every barrier is declared resolved after one additional option is introduced.
questions.explanation: 末段要求检查学习者随后能解释或完成什么，而第三段强调展示预期能力，因此 B 最直接。A 只是形式印象，C 忽视目标差别，D 超出单次调整可支持的结论。

questions.prompt: “Conflate” in paragraph 6 is closest in meaning to _____.
options: compare two ideas in order to identify their differences
revise an expectation after evaluating its consequences
confuse distinct ideas by treating them as the same
offer a different method for achieving a particular aim
questions.explanation: 该句提醒不要把共同知识要求和统一实现路径混同，前文又反复区分目标与形式，所以 conflate 对应 C。A 恰好是作出区分，D 则是文章建议的做法而非该词含义。
